fact_text: Fundamental analysis covers a company's plans and production, while technical analysis uses price charts to judge the levels at which a stock can be bought or sold.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '1. Introduction to Technical Analysis: Kickoff to Our New Series | PSX & Equity Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-06)

fact_text: Support and resistance levels, read from a price chart, are core technical inputs for timing purchases and sales.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '1. Introduction to Technical Analysis: Kickoff to Our New Series | PSX & Equity Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-06)

fact_text: Technical analysis can help an investor avoid buying a fundamentally sound stock at a high price and reduce panic when a correction pushes it into a loss.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '1. Introduction to Technical Analysis: Kickoff to Our New Series | PSX & Equity Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-08-06)

fact_text: The Relative Strength Index is described as a strong indicator that professional traders use in their trading.
